subSections.text: [1] ANCOVA of the change from baseline: treatment and pooled site group as factors, the baseline value as a covariate.
[2] Dose response: the test that the coefficient of the planned dose (0, 54, 81), taken as a continuous variable in the same model, is 0.
[3] Pairwise: treatment as a categorical variable; differences of LS means with their standard errors and 95% confidence intervals; p-values not adjusted for multiplicity.

[1] Mixed model for repeated measures of the change from baseline at weeks 8, 16 and 24, observed records: treatment, pooled site group, week and treatment by week as factors; the baseline value and baseline by week as covariates; unstructured covariance; Kenward-Roger standard errors and degrees of freedom. LS means and their differences at Week 24; p-values not adjusted for multiplicity.
